| `redundancy.nodes[].metadataQueueLength` | integer | format: "int64" | MetadataQueueLength is the sum of the Merkle-updater and insert queues. |
| `redundancy.nodes[].metadataSyncPartitions` | integer | format: "int32" | MetadataSyncPartitions is the sum over tables of partitions left in the current full-sync pass. It is 0 between passes. |
| `redundancy.nodes[].nodeId` | string | required; pattern: "^\[0-9a-f\]{64}$" | NodeID is the full Garage node ID. |
| `redundancy.nodes[].observed` | boolean | required | Observed is false when the node did not answer this pass; the counters then keep their previous values. |
| `redundancy.nodes[].resyncIdle` | boolean |  | ResyncIdle is true when every enabled resync worker is idle. |
| `redundancy.nodes[].resyncQueueLength` | integer | format: "int64" | ResyncQueueLength is the node's block resync queue, including delayed rechecks. |
| `redundancy.progressObservedAt` | string | format: "date-time" | ProgressObservedAt is when nodes\[\] was last rewritten. Progress is rewritten at most once per minute unless another redundancy field changes in the same pass, and only when a value changed. |
| `redundancy.scope` | string | enum: \["Cluster", "Local"\] | Scope is Cluster when every storage role of the layout runs at this site, and Local when other sites run some of them; the proof covers only this site's local storage nodes. |
| `redundancy.storageNodes` | object |  | StorageNodes counts the layout's storage roles for this site. |
| `redundancy.storageNodes.local` | integer | required; format: "int32"; min: 0 | Local is the number of storage roles that run at this site. |
| `redundancy.storageNodes.remote` | integer | required; format: "int32"; min: 0 | Remote is the number of storage roles that run at other sites. |
| `redundancy.storageNodes.total` | integer | required; format: "int32"; min: 0 | Total is the number of storage roles across all sites. |
| `redundancy.storageNodes.verified` | integer | required; format: "int32"; min: 0 | Verified is the number of local storage nodes the current or last proof has completed. |
| `redundancy.verification` | object |  | Verification is the proof state. Absent on a federated site without spec.layoutManagement.siteRole. |
| `redundancy.verification.completedNodeIds` | array of string | max items: 256 | CompletedNodeIDs are the owned storage nodes that finished this proof, sorted. |
| `redundancy.verification.currentNodeId` | string | pattern: "^\[0-9a-f\]{64}$" | CurrentNodeID is the owned storage node whose turn it is. Repairs run on one storage node at a time. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence` | object |  | Evidence is the internal proof state. Its shape may change between operator releases; an unrecognized shape restarts the current node. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.blockErrorsBaseline` | integer | format: "int64" | BlockErrorsBaseline is the block-error count at the start of the current 30-minute window used to detect a growing count. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.blockErrorsBaselineAt` | string | format: "date-time" | BlockErrorsBaselineAt is when the current block-error window opened. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.idleSince` | string | format: "date-time" | IdleSince is the first pass, after the tables launch, at which the current node's sync workers were idle and its metadata queues empty. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.launches` | integer | format: "int32"; min: 0; max: 3 | Launches counts the launches of the current node's stage. After three the node is deferred as RepairFailed. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.nodeStage` | string | enum: \["Tables", "Blocks", "Pause"\] | NodeStage is the current node's step. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.pauseUntil` | string | format: "date-time" | PauseUntil ends the pause after the current node finished. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.peerDownSeen` | boolean |  | PeerDownSeen is true when some storage node was down during the current node's table sync. Sync errors are then expected; the node is rechecked with a tables-only pass once every node is up. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.quietSince` | string | format: "date-time" | QuietSince starts the final quiet period. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.repairWorkerId` | integer | format: "int64" | RepairWorkerID is the blocks repair worker adopted on the current node. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.resyncErrorBaselines` | map of integer |  | ResyncErrorBaselines is the persistent-error counter of every block resync worker on the owned nodes when the quiet period started. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.skipTables` | boolean |  | SkipTables is true for a proof started by a layout change: Garage's settled layout history already proves a full table sync on every node. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.stageLaunchedAt` | string | format: "date-time" | StageLaunchedAt is when the current node's repair was launched. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.syncErrorBaselines` | map of integer |  | SyncErrorBaselines is the errors counter of each of the five "<table> sync" workers of the current node at the tables launch. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.tablesRecheckNodeIds` | array of string | max items: 256 | TablesRecheckNodeIDs are completed nodes whose table sync ran while a peer was down; each gets a tables-only pass once every node is up. |
| `redundancy.verification.evidence.workerBaseline` | integer | format: "int64" | WorkerBaseline is the current node's highest worker ID at the launch. A lower maximum later means Garage restarted. |
| `redundancy.verification.layoutVersion` | integer | format: "int64"; min: 0 | LayoutVersion is the Garage layout version last observed. |
| `redundancy.verification.phase` | string | required; enum: \["Idle", "Pending", "SyncingMetadata", "ScanningBlocks", "Settling", "Partial", "Verified"\] | Phase is the proof step. |
| `redundancy.verification.phaseStartedAt` | string | format: "date-time" | PhaseStartedAt is when Phase was entered. |
| `redundancy.verification.requestToken` | string | max length: 253 | RequestToken is the last handled value of the garage.rajsingh.info/verify-redundancy annotation. |
| `redundancy.verification.startedAt` | string | format: "date-time" | StartedAt is when the current proof attempt began. |
| `redundancy.verification.topologyHash` | string | max length: 64 | TopologyHash fingerprints the ID, zone and capacity of every storage role in the current layout. A change after the baseline starts a proof; tag-only layout changes and Pod restarts do not change it. |
| `redundancy.verification.trigger` | string | enum: \["Requested", "LayoutChanged", "NodeChanged"\] | Trigger is what started the current proof. Absent while Idle. |
| `redundancy.verification.verifiedAt` | string | format: "date-time" | VerifiedAt is when the last proof completed. It survives later proofs and outages, so it records the last time full redundancy was proven. |
| `remoteClusters` | array of object |  | RemoteClusters contains status of remote clusters in the federation. |
| `remoteClusters[].connected` | boolean |  | Connected indicates if we can reach this cluster. |
| `remoteClusters[].healthyNodes` | integer |  | HealthyNodes is the number of healthy nodes. |
| `remoteClusters[].lastSeen` | string | format: "date-time" | LastSeen is when we last successfully connected. |
| `remoteClusters[].name` | string |  | Name is the cluster name. |
| `remoteClusters[].nodes` | integer |  | Nodes is the number of nodes in this cluster. |
| `remoteClusters[].zone` | string |  | Zone is the cluster's zone. |
| `replicas` | integer | required; format: "int32" | Replicas is the total number of Garage pods targeted by this cluster (storage + gateway tiers combined). |
| `resyncQueueLength` | integer | format: "int64" | ResyncQueueLength is the total block resync queue depth across all nodes. Absent means not observed (Admin API unreachable, or a node that can hold blocks did not answer; silent capacityless gateways are ignored). 0 means observed and drained. |
| `scaleReplicas` | integer | format: "int32" | ScaleReplicas is the actual number of non-terminating Pods in the workload projected through the requested API version's scale subresource. For storage and unified clusters this is only the Auto-managed default StatefulSet/PVC group; node-local pools, Manual GarageNodes, and unified gateways are excluded. A gateway-only hub object carries its gateway Pod count solely to preserve the legacy v1beta1 Scale projection; v1beta2 gateway-only Scale updates are rejected. |
| `scaleSelector` | string |  | ScaleSelector is the serialized exact selector for the Pods counted by ScaleReplicas. It normally selects the default storage group; on a gateway-only hub object it selects the gateway Pods for legacy v1beta1 Scale reads. It is kept separate from the aggregate Selector so hidden workloads cannot make /scale fail to converge. |
| `scrubStatus` | object |  | ScrubStatus contains the status of data scrub operations. Deprecated: never populated by the operator. It will be removed in the next API version. |
| `scrubStatus.corruptedBlocks` | integer | format: "int32" | CorruptedBlocks is the number of corrupted blocks found in the last scrub. |
| `scrubStatus.lastCompleted` | string | format: "date-time" | LastCompleted is when the last scrub completed. |
| `scrubStatus.nextRun` | string | format: "date-time" | NextRun is when the next scrub is scheduled to run. |
| `scrubStatus.nodeStatuses` | array of object |  | NodeStatuses contains per-node scrub status. |
| `scrubStatus.nodeStatuses[].errorsFound` | integer | format: "int32" | ErrorsFound is the number of errors found on this node. |
| `scrubStatus.nodeStatuses[].itemsChecked` | integer | format: "int64" | ItemsChecked is the number of items checked. |
| `scrubStatus.nodeStatuses[].nodeId` | string |  | NodeID is the node identifier. |
| `scrubStatus.nodeStatuses[].progress` | integer |  | Progress percentage (0-100). |
| `scrubStatus.nodeStatuses[].running` | boolean |  | Running indicates if scrub is running on this node. |
| `scrubStatus.paused` | boolean |  | Paused indicates if the scrub is paused. |
| `scrubStatus.progress` | string |  | Progress is a human-readable progress description. |
| `scrubStatus.running` | boolean |  | Running indicates if a scrub is currently running on any node. |
| `scrubStatus.tranquilityLevel` | integer |  | TranquilityLevel is the current tranquility setting. |
| `selector` | string | required | Selector is the aggregate serialized label selector for pods managed by this cluster. It is not used by the scale subresource. |
| `stagedLayoutVersion` | integer | format: "int64" | StagedLayoutVersion is the staged layout version pending application. |
| `stagedRoles` | integer | format: "int32" | StagedRoles is the number of roles in the staged layout. |
| `storageDrain` | object |  | StorageDrain records the single cluster-wide positive-capacity removal and block-migration proof. It excludes every other layout mutation until the exact actor completes its Kubernetes handoff. |
| `storageDrain.actor` | object | required | Actor is the exact object authorized to advance this transaction. |
| `storageDrain.actor.apiVersion` | string | required | APIVersion is the actor's Kubernetes API version. |
| `storageDrain.actor.kind` | string | required; enum: \["GarageCluster", "GarageNode"\] | Kind is GarageCluster for a cluster-wide Drain deletion or GarageNode for one logical storage member's permanent role removal. |
| `storageDrain.actor.name` | string | required | Name is the actor's Kubernetes object name. |
| `storageDrain.actor.namespace` | string | required | Namespace is the actor's Kubernetes namespace. |
| `storageDrain.actor.uid` | string | required | UID is the immutable Kubernetes UID of the actor incarnation. |
| `storageDrain.completedAt` | string | format: "date-time" | CompletedAt is set only after exact repair workers completed cleanly and every enabled block-resync worker passed the terminal safety checks. The transaction remains active until Actor completes its Kubernetes handoff. |
| `storageDrain.errorCount` | integer | required; format: "int64" | ErrorCount is the aggregate number of block resync errors. |
| `storageDrain.layoutVersion` | integer | required; format: "int64" | LayoutVersion is the current Garage layout version observed with these verification processes and queue counters. |
| `storageDrain.managedPodUids` | map of string |  | ManagedPodUIDs fingerprints the exact locally managed Garage processes observed when this proof revision started. Any pod replacement invalidates worker-ID baselines because Garage worker counters can restart from zero. Keys are full Garage node IDs and values are Kubernetes Pod UIDs. |
| `storageDrain.queueLength` | integer | required; format: "int64" | QueueLength is the observed aggregate block-resync queue depth. It is informational: Garage also queues future garbage collection, so readiness is based on completed repair workers and idle resync workers instead. |
| `storageDrain.quietSince` | string | format: "date-time" | QuietSince starts after every exact repair worker completes without errors and resync-worker error baselines are recorded. The operator waits through Garage's maximum known delayed-resync interval, then requires every exact resync worker idle and error-free before a process may be stopped. |
| `storageDrain.removedStorageNodeIds` | array of string | required | RemovedStorageNodeIDs is the sorted positive-capacity subset whose removal requires block-migration proof. Recording it before Apply keeps the safety gate durable across controller crashes and Admin API failures. |
| `storageDrain.repairBaselines` | map of integer |  | RepairBaselines records each storage node's highest worker ID before the operator launches a transaction-specific Blocks repair. It is persisted before launch so a crash cannot lose ownership of the resulting worker. |
| `storageDrain.repairWorkerIds` | map of integer |  | RepairWorkerIDs records the exact post-baseline Blocks repair worker whose clean completion was observed on each source and destination process in VerificationNodeIDs. |
| `storageDrain.requiresEmptyQueue` | boolean | required | RequiresEmptyQueue is true when at least one verification process is not proven to use this GarageCluster's authoritative RPC timeout. In that case the normally informational future-work queue must also become empty. |
| `storageDrain.resyncErrorBaselines` | map of integer |  | ResyncErrorBaselines records the cumulative error counter of every exact enabled block-resync worker after all repair scans complete. Any increase restarts the repair transaction. |
| `storageDrain.roleRemovalNodeIds` | array of string | required | RoleRemovalNodeIDs is the sorted set of every exact Garage layout role this actor is authorized to remove, including capacityless gateway roles in a unified cluster Drain. |
| `storageDrain.startedAt` | string | required; format: "date-time" | StartedAt records when the pre-Apply removal intent became durable. |
| `storageDrain.targetHash` | string | required | TargetHash fingerprints both normalized target sets. Every status update compares both transactionId and targetHash so a stale reconcile cannot overwrite a newer target revision owned by the same actor. |
| `storageDrain.transactionId` | string | required | TransactionID distinguishes separate drains owned by the same object UID. |
| `storageDrain.unavailableSourceNodeIds` | array of string |  | UnavailableSourceNodeIDs is the sorted subset of removedStorageNodeIds whose processes and local disks were explicitly acknowledged as permanently lost. Those sources cannot run the normal Blocks scan; the terminal proof instead covers every surviving positive-capacity destination after an administrator removes the exact dead role through Garage's recovery workflow. Data present only on a listed source may be lost. |
| `storageDrain.verificationNodeIds` | array of string |  | VerificationNodeIDs is the sorted union of removed source processes and current positive-capacity destinations covered by this transaction's completed block-repair scans. |
| `storageReadyReplicas` | integer | format: "int32" | StorageReadyReplicas is the aggregate number of storage identities that are connected and committed in Garage's layout. |
| `storageReplicas` | integer | format: "int32" | StorageReplicas is the aggregate desired/current storage identity count across the default group, ordinary Manual GarageNodes, and node-local pools. Use ScaleReplicas for the narrow Kubernetes Scale projection. |
| `storageRollout` | object |  | StorageRollout is the controller-owned durable record for the single managed storage/gateway pod currently being replaced. Nil when no parent-controlled rollout handoff is active. |
| `storageRollout.clusterGeneration` | integer | format: "int64" | ClusterGeneration is the most recent recovery-safe GarageCluster spec generation published into this actor's desired workload template. |
| `storageRollout.desiredConfigHash` | string | required | DesiredConfigHash is the rendered Garage configuration revision. |
| `storageRollout.desiredPodSpecHash` | string | required | DesiredPodSpecHash is the operator-computed pod template revision. |
| `storageRollout.garageNodeGeneration` | integer | format: "int64" | GarageNodeGeneration is the exact actor's most recently published workload-safe spec generation, including the generated GarageNode behind a node-local-pool actor. |
| `storageRollout.garageNodeId` | string | required | GarageNodeID is the exact Garage identity reported by the selected actor before its Pod is deleted. A replacement must rediscover this same identity; a new ID under the same Kubernetes objects is never accepted as a handoff. |
| `storageRollout.garageNodeName` | string |  | GarageNodeName identifies a StatefulSet-backed PVC, SMB, or gateway actor. Mutually exclusive with NodeLocalPoolName and KubernetesNodeName. |
| `storageRollout.garageNodeUid` | string | required | GarageNodeUID anchors the actor to one immutable GarageNode incarnation. It is recorded for StatefulSet and node-local-pool actors alike. |
| `storageRollout.kubernetesNodeName` | string |  | KubernetesNodeName identifies the Kubernetes Node represented by a node-local-pool actor. |
| `storageRollout.kubernetesNodeUid` | string |  | KubernetesNodeUID anchors a node-local-pool actor to the Kubernetes Node incarnation whose HostPath storage was validated. Empty for StatefulSets. |
| `storageRollout.nodeLocalPoolName` | string |  | NodeLocalPoolName identifies a spec.storage.nodeLocalPools entry. |
| `storageRollout.persistentVolumeClaims` | array of object |  | PersistentVolumeClaims anchors a StatefulSet-backed actor to every exact PVC mounted by the Pod selected for replacement. Recreated/deleting claims fail closed so controller-incarnation recovery cannot bind empty storage or silently create a new Garage identity under a reused claim name. Empty for node-local-pool HostPath actors. |
| `storageRollout.persistentVolumeClaims[].name` | string | required | Name is the namespaced PVC referenced by the selected Pod. |
| `storageRollout.persistentVolumeClaims[].uid` | string | required | UID is the exact Kubernetes PVC incarnation that contains the actor's metadata/data at selection time. |
| `storageRollout.previousPodUid` | string | required | PreviousPodUID is persisted before the OnDelete pod is deleted. Recovery never accepts this UID as the completed replacement. |
| `storageRollout.recoveryPodName` | string |  | RecoveryPodName and RecoveryPodUID identify the one failed replacement durably selected for retry deletion. They are written before DELETE and retained until that exact UID is absent, making the operation idempotent across manager and API failures. Both are empty when no retry deletion is pending. |
| `storageRollout.recoveryPodUid` | string |  |  |
| `storageRollout.recoveryRequest` | string |  | RecoveryRequest is the last recover-storage-rollout annotation nonce the controller durably consumed before deleting a failed replacement again. |
| `storageRollout.retiredWorkloadUids` | array of string | max items: 32 | RetiredWorkloadUIDs records workload-controller incarnations that were replaced behind a scheduling fence. Late Pods from these exact UIDs remain identifiable without trusting reused names; node-local-pool recovery waits for them to disappear rather than deleting healthy non-candidate members. Recovery fails closed before a 33rd retired controller incarnation so this exact old-Pod exclusion set remains bounded in parent status. |
| `storageRollout.statefulSetWorkloadRecreationSafe` | boolean |  | StatefulSetWorkloadRecreationSafe records that the selected StatefulSet's volumeClaimTemplate retention policy does not delete claims when the StatefulSet is deleted. It is false for node-local-pool actors and causes missing StatefulSet recovery to fail closed when claim retention was unsafe. |
| `storageRollout.workloadFenced` | boolean |  | WorkloadFenced is true after a replacement StatefulSet/DaemonSet UID was CAS-adopted but before that controller was allowed to schedule its first Pod (replicas=0 for StatefulSet, impossible nodeSelector for DaemonSet). |
| `storageRollout.workloadUid` | string | required | WorkloadUID is the exact StatefulSet or DaemonSet controller incarnation authorized to create and replace this actor's Pod. |
| `storageStats` | object |  | StorageStats contains cluster-wide storage statistics. |
| `storageStats.availableCapacity` | integer or string | pattern: "^(\\+\|-)?((\[0-9\]+(\\.\[0-9\]*)?)\|(\\.\[0-9\]+))((\[KMGTPE\]i)\|\[numkMGTPE\]\|(\[eE\](\\+\|-)?((\[0-9\]+(\\.\[0-9\]*)?)\|(\\.\[0-9\]+))))?$" | AvailableCapacity is the available storage across all nodes. |
| `storageStats.healthyPartitions` | integer | format: "int32" | HealthyPartitions is the number of partitions with full redundancy. |
| `storageStats.totalCapacity` | integer or string | pattern: "^(\\+\|-)?((\[0-9\]+(\\.\[0-9\]*)?)\|(\\.\[0-9\]+))((\[KMGTPE\]i)\|\[numkMGTPE\]\|(\[eE\](\\+\|-)?((\[0-9\]+(\\.\[0-9\]*)?)\|(\\.\[0-9\]+))))?$" | TotalCapacity is the total storage capacity across all nodes. |
| `storageStats.totalPartitions` | integer | format: "int32" | TotalPartitions is the total number of partitions in the layout. |
| `storageStats.usedCapacity` | integer or string | pattern: "^(\\+\|-)?((\[0-9\]+(\\.\[0-9\]*)?)\|(\\.\[0-9\]+))((\[KMGTPE\]i)\|\[numkMGTPE\]\|(\[eE\](\\+\|-)?((\[0-9\]+(\\.\[0-9\]*)?)\|(\\.\[0-9\]+))))?$" | UsedCapacity is the used storage across all nodes. |
| `totalNodes` | integer |  | TotalNodes is the total nodes across all clusters (local + remote). Deprecated: never populated by the operator. It will be removed in the next API version. |
| `unreachablePeers` | array of string |  | UnreachablePeers lists peers that have been continuously down beyond the sustained-unreachable threshold, each as "<shortNodeId> (down <duration>)". Drives the PeerUnreachable condition. Empty when all peers are reachable. |
| `workerCount` | integer | format: "int32" | WorkerCount is the total number of background workers. Deprecated: never populated by the operator. It will be removed in the next API version. |
| `workers` | object |  | Workers contains detailed information about background workers. Deprecated: never populated by the operator. It will be removed in the next API version. |
| `workers.busy` | integer | format: "int32" | Busy is the number of busy/active workers. |
| `workers.errored` | integer | format: "int32" | Errored is the number of workers with errors. |
| `workers.errors` | array of object |  | Errors contains details about worker errors. |
| `workers.errors[].consecutiveErrors` | integer | format: "int32" | ConsecutiveErrors is the count of consecutive errors. |
| `workers.errors[].lastError` | string |  | LastError is the last error message. |
| `workers.errors[].lastErrorSecsAgo` | integer | format: "int64" | LastErrorSecsAgo is seconds since the last error. |
| `workers.errors[].name` | string |  | Name is the worker name. |
| `workers.errors[].workerId` | integer | format: "int64" | WorkerID is the worker identifier. |
| `workers.idle` | integer | format: "int32" | Idle is the number of idle workers. |
| `workers.total` | integer | format: "int32" | Total is the total number of background workers. |
| `workers.variables` | map of string |  | Variables contains runtime worker configuration variables. |
| `workersFailed` | integer | format: "int32" | WorkersFailed is the number of failed workers. Deprecated: never populated by the operator. It will be removed in the next API version. |
